title: Microsoft Entra ID - Security Overview
description:
Investigate Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and audit logs: failed and flagged sign-ins, failing service principals, and changes to roles, app credentials, consents, and authentication methods, with the Cloud SIEM signals they raise.

- [Microsoft Entra ID integration](https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/azure-active-directory/)
- [Datadog Cloud SIEM](https://docs.datadoghq.com/security/cloud_siem/)

definition.content:
Use this dashboard to investigate Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and audit activity: who is failing to sign in and from where, sign-ins from flagged IPs, failing service principals, and changes to roles, application credentials, consents, and authentication methods.

Filter by user, actor, client IP, application, country, or log category with the template variables.

For further reading, see:

- [Microsoft Entra ID integration](https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/azure-active-directory/)
- [Entra ID audit logs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/monitoring-health/concept-audit-logs)
- [Entra ID sign-in logs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/monitoring-health/concept-sign-ins)
- [Datadog Cloud SIEM](https://docs.datadoghq.com/security/cloud_siem/)

Datadog Cloud SIEM analyzes and correlates Microsoft Entra ID logs to detect threats to your environment in real time. If you don't see signals, make sure you've enabled and configured [Datadog Cloud SIEM](/security/siem).

search.query: source:azure.activedirectory @evt.category:AuditLogs @evt.name:("Add member to role" OR "Add eligible member to role in PIM completed (permanent)" OR "Add eligible member to role in PIM completed (timebound)" OR "Add member to role in PIM completed (permanent)" OR "Add member to role in PIM completed (timebound)" OR "Add member to role completed (PIM activation)" OR "Add scoped member to role") $User $Actor $ClientIP $Application $Country $LogCategory

definition.title: Credentials added to applications by actor

search.query: source:azure.activedirectory @evt.category:AuditLogs @evt.name:("Add service principal credentials" OR "Update application – Certificates and secrets management" OR "Update application – Certificates and secrets management " OR "Create application – Certificates and secrets management" OR "Create application – Certificates and secrets management ") $User $Actor $ClientIP $Application $Country $LogCategory
